Context: 8. Pensionary terms for Central Government Employees absorbed consequent on conversion of Departments into Autonomous Body or a PSU

4. The permanent absorption shall take effect from the date on which their options are accepted by the Government and from that date such absorbed employees shall be deemed to have retired from Government service. The posts which they were holding in the Government before such absorption will stand abolished.
5. Employees who opt to revert back to Government service will be
7. redeployed through the Surplus Cell within two years.
